title.narrative: Mozambique Mining and Gas Technical Assistance Project

description.narrative: The development objective of the Mining and Gas Technical Assistance Project is to strengthen the capacity and governance systems of key institutions to manage the mining and hydrocarbon sectors in Mozambique. There are five components to the project. The first component is mining governance capacity building and reform. The second component covers natural gas capacity building and governance reform. The third component is cross-cutting mining and natural gas capacity building and reforms. The fourth component focuses on cross-sectoral reforms. The fifth component provides project management and coordination.
The proposed project development objective is to strengthen the capacity and governance systems of key institutions to manage the mining and hydrocarbon sectors in Mozambique.

title.narrative: Annual disclosure of reports on extractive industries revenues and revenue allocation at national level

comment.narrative: <p>The 10th report of the ITIEM was launched in 14th of September, 2022 and the 11th report is done and delivered - concluded.</p>

title.narrative: New mining/gas/infrastructure concessionary contracts negotiated, benefitting from developed frameworks and procedures supported by the project

comment.narrative: <p>During the course of the project, FID was reached on a number of mining projects, as well as notably on the Area I and Area IV gas megaprojects</p>

title.narrative: Staff of gas sector management institutions trained through MAGTAP to manage, regulate and monitor gas sector

comment.narrative: <p>This include ENH, INP as well MIREME.</p>

title.narrative: Mines and quarries construction projects and gas project developments subject to technical inspections in line with international industry standards.

comment.narrative:
<p>On the mining side, most inspections have been done in quarries in the south of the country (Maputo Province) due to constraints in operational costs to cover the trips.</p>

<p>On the gas side, as part of the technical inspection process, INP approved the (i) Field Development Plan for Coral, (ii) Golfinho/Atum, (iii) Rovuma LNG and (iv) Inhassoro and (v)Temane (PSA area) Development Plan Amendment .</p>

<p> </p>

title.narrative: Number of ASMs who have received targeted training (of which female %)

comment.narrative:
<p>Trainings still in progress. This is an activity that continues even after the implementation of MAGTAP, as MAGTAP has trained MIREME trainers who are now responsible for training MIREME staff.</p>
<p>The reach of this indicator is low compared to the target because the activity that feeds into this indicator took a long time to start its implementation. On the other hand, the equipment needed for the trainings took a while to arrive in Maputo (it was purchased from abroad). However, as MAGTAP was progressing towards its closure, it was not possible to achieve the target.</p>

<p>This number includes all people that have benefited from training plans (short term courses) since 2013 until now and also conferences, workshops and courses funded by MAGTAP .</p>
<p>The target of 3500 is the result of the budgetary revision conducted during the implementation of MAGTAP. It is considered an extremely high number to achieve - an ambitious goal that proved challenging for MAGTAP to reach.</p>

title.narrative: Mining and gas operations subject to annual cost and fiscal audits in compliance with the established fiscal regime

comment.narrative:
<p>Cost recovery audits were conducted at Area 1 and Area 4, covering the financial years 2015, 2016 & 2017.</p>
<p> </p>

title.narrative: Local law enforcement and judicial personnel trained on mining law and regulations under the project

comment.narrative: <p>With the existence funds was possible to train more than 200 people (project target). The number of districts with mining activity grew and the project had to include in the training’s sessions the technicians from these new districts, too. Additionally, regional (North, Centre and South of Mozambique) trainings were carried out, where was possible to have more people joining.</p>

title.narrative: Number of studies with specific recommendations completed and adopted to stimulate linkages between mining and gas projects and Mozambican economy

comment.narrative:
<p>MAGTAP funded Project “Enhancing the competitiveness of national MSMEs to participate within the supply chains of large Mining, Oil & Gas Projects in Mozambique”</p>

<p>Such resulted in 3 deliverables, namely: (i) “Study of priority niches for value chain analysis”, (ii) Study of models of assistance for pilot MSMEs and the role of IPEME in such models” and (iii) “Study to propose a framework of incentives, rates and taxes”! all studies had the main objective to enhancing the competitiveness of MSMEs working with large Mining, Oil & Gas Projects in Mozambique.</p>

<p>Due that capacity building, IPEME was able to contribute in (1) Draft of National Content Law; (2) Recommendations to the "Review of New Matrix of the SME Development Strategy and Operational Strategic Plan 2019-2021", (3) Recommendation of "Revision of policy instruments and incentives for the improvement of the doing business environment".</p>

title.narrative: Number of CSO/CBOs trained on transparency monitoring across the extractive sector value chain

comment.narrative:
<p>This number reflects the people that has been trained or attended the seminars through the project: “Enhance of CSOs/CBO about EITI” which comprises CSOs, Government entities, private companies as Communities surrounded by extractive sector- Journalists were also trained to be able to properly write and publish the extractive sector information.</p>
<p>The reason why the achievement is very high is that there was a lot of demand from CSOs for information in this sector (oil and gas) and the issue of managing expectations in relation to training/resources.</p>

title.narrative: Number of studies assessing economic and financial feasibility for development of gas infrastructure carried out

comment.narrative:
<p> (1) Feasibility study for the Farm in the PSA;</p>

<p>(2) Business Plan for ENH Logistic;</p>

<p>(3) Financial Advisory Services for ENH,</p>

<p>(4) Initial Phase of the LNG Project;</p>

<p>(5) Pre-feasibility study for the transport of natural gas from Palma to South.</p>

title.narrative: Provincial Directorates of Mineral Resources equipped & capable to monitor and inspect mining & exploration operations in their jurisdictions

comment.narrative: <p>The project funded the acquisition of Cars, motorbikes, bicycles, computers including camp equipment. The materials have been allocated to several province of Mozambique. For example, cars and motorbikes were distributed to all provinces, bicycles mainly Tete, Manica and Niassa.</p>

<p>This numbers reflects the ASM associations/cooperatives funded by state budget. But these improvements are a reflection also of capacity building given to DNGM and INAMI through courses and seminars.</p>

title.narrative: Standards & procedures for oil & gas contingency planning & emergency preparations developed

comment.narrative: <p>This activity was canceled due to the lack of project implementation timeline.</p>

title.narrative: Procedures of tendering and evaluation of mineral assets developed

comment.narrative: <p>This activity´s indicator was canceled. It was not MIREME´s priority anymore.</p>

title.narrative: Computerized Environmental and Social Management Information System developed

comment.narrative: <p>This will not be possible to do because Mining cadaster, Ministry of Land and Revenue authority each one has a different system. Several tentative were made but the technology systems are so huge and advanced that is impossible to merger them.</p>
